shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files app"
/bin/bash -c "test -d node_modules/next/dist/docs && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -100 || true; printf '\\n--- entry files ---\\n'; rg --files | head -120"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---'; cat app/page.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- layout ---'; cat app/layout.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- config and typescript ---'; cat next.config.ts; cat tsconfig.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log("'`${request.method} ${request.nextUrl.pathname}`)
+
+  return NextResponse.next()
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build'
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json package.json && git diff --no-index /dev/null proxy.ts || true'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'

@@

-      \"@/*\": [

@@
-  \"include\": [

 }

rg -n 'clean' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/06-cli/next.md | head -20
git status --short"
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
